title: Coherence of finite perfect adic coordinate transitions
statement: Given the transition maps of [new-w5-finite-perfect-adic-coordinate-transition-maps] and actual realizations of [new-w5-finite-perfect-adic-coordinate-realizations], the scalar-realization maps satisfy the consecutive-tower equation through the canonical scalar coherence of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-coherence].

source.place: Tag 06YY, after transport through the comparisons of Tags 09AL and 09C6.

proof.text: Pull the two coordinate comparisons to every chart and restriction, and apply the naturality equations of the canonical scalar compositor in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-coherence].

The lifted square defining each dK_n identifies the transported composite with the strict restricted-tower transition. Cancellation by the comparison isomorphisms gives exactly the displayed equation.
